architecture.summary: Documents only. The SO-12 release record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s2-release.md records step 8 of the production order on 1 November 2026: signup open from 04:02 to 05:45 UTC, the canary signup of a fresh account that made the organization AlphaSig and its tenant in 106 s, the canary's tool call through its tenant, the login lesson, and the closing deploy; the owner items 11 and the record row 8 take their status. The free subscription guide docs/free-subscription-guide.md gains one note in section 3: the login reuses the WorkOS session of the browser window, so a fresh-account test opens the login link in a private window of that account. No source, test, configuration, workflow, migration, or Mermaid block changes; the registry stays accurate.
